target_customer: Independent and small dental practices that buy supplies from several distributors
problem: Dental offices spend time and money comparing prices and placing orders across many supplier sites.
business_model: Free procurement and price comparison platform for practices; the company states no subscription fees, so revenue presumably comes from supplier side economics (not confirmed)
product_category: Vertical B2B procurement marketplace and aggregator

founders.name: Sabrine Obbad
prior_employers: Pharmaceutical research roles in protein biochemistry (employers not named)
founders.background_notes: Pediatric dentist and private practice owner per the YC page.

founders.name: Elyas Obbad
founders.background_notes: Per YC page, led engineering on large scale AI systems and published at ICML and NeurIPS.

technical_complexity.rationale: Aggregating supplier catalogs and prices and a multi vendor cart is mostly integration and data cleaning work, with catalog scale (the company claims over 300,000 supplies) as the main difficulty.

defensibility.rationale: Supplier catalogs and prices can be scraped or integrated by others, and price comparison tools already existed. Moats would come from supplier relationships and order history.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Not observed. No source found reports incumbents copying or buying the wedge.

market_need_then: ADA data cited in coverage shows dental equipment and supply prices rose about 5% between early and September 2025, and the founders describe the procurement mess from the dentist's own experience.

branding.name_origin: The company site says the name draws on the radiology principle ALARA, as low as reasonably achievable, applied to costs, stress and wasted time.
branding.domain_note: Uses alaradental.com, a suffixed domain, not alara.com.

identity.logo: not described by any source found
identity.voice_and_tone: practical savings messaging aimed at practice owners

branding.brand_signature: The ALARA radiology principle used as a name story

brand_strength.rationale: The name has a clever insider meaning for dental professionals, but no press or community evidence about the brand was found and the domain needs a suffix.

outcome_analysis: Alara is a Summer 2025 company founded by a practicing dentist and a former big tech AI engineer, a strong founder market fit for dental procurement. It is still active with blog posts through March 2026 and no reported shutdown or acquisition. Funding, traction and revenue are not confirmed by any primary source, so the trajectory beyond the early stage cannot be assessed.
notes: Funding unverified: aggregators (StartupIntros, FundedIQ, Caplight) report a $500K seed on 2025-09-01 with investors including Atomico, Creandum, FJ Labs, Goat Capital, kfund, Pro Founders Capital, Scale Venture Partners, Teamworthy and Y Combinator, but no company post or press release was found, so it is not recorded as a round. The company website returned HTTP 429 on two fetches, so it was not read directly; the name origin comes from a search snippet of the company's own site. A job listing aggregator names Kamal Obbad as CEO, which conflicts with the YC page and is not used. Competitors such as ZenOne, SupplyClinic and MethodUSA appear only in undated vendor pages, so the list is empty.
